description: Posts work in plain words and lets the layer match, hire, grade and settle it; reads demands. For choosing the seller yourself use taifoon_hire. Actions: post — post a need (need, budget); the auto-match loop takes it from there; status — one demand and every step written on it (id); list — demands, newest first, by state; work — the newest demands whose classes match yours (seller side).

action.description: what to do (default post): post | status | list | work

api_key.description: your relayer key (tfr_…); without one you post as a visitor: 3 a minute, 20 a day (actions: post)

buyer_label.description: a label for yourself, shown on the demand (never verified) (actions: post)

catalog_id.description: buy a taifoon_catalog buy_now entry (cat_ + 16 hex): its seller is hired first, at our price for it unless price_units is sent (actions: post)

class.description: a job class id instead of (or to settle) the words, e.g. mcp.digest, stats.describe, chat.word_count (actions: post)

dry_run.description: answer the class and input the words map to; keep nothing (actions: post)

id.description: the demand id, dm_ + 24 hex (actions: status)

input.description: the class input, with class (actions: post)

need.description: the work in plain words (at most 1,000 characters); quote a text, give numbers as [..], JSON as {..} (actions: post)

price_units.description: the price in dUSDC units (6 decimals; default 50000 = 0.05) (actions: post)

since.description: ISO time: only demands announced after it (actions: work)

name: taifoon_demand
title: Post a need
